#!/bin/bash
set -e

export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

# 确定代码目录（用有 scripts/ 的那个）
if [ -d "/root/autodl-tmp/solver-trace-ablation/scripts" ]; then
    CODE_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/solver-trace-ablation"
elif [ -d "/root/solver-trace-ablation/scripts" ]; then
    CODE_DIR="/root/solver-trace-ablation"
else
    echo "ERROR: Cannot find solver-trace-ablation code directory"
    exit 1
fi
cd $CODE_DIR

OUT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/outputs"

# 函数：训练 + eval + classify
run_one() {
    local CONDITION=$1  # "isr" or "random"
    local SEED=$2
    local CONFIG
    local REWARD_MODE
    local OUT_DIR
    
    if [ "$CONDITION" = "isr" ]; then
        CONFIG="configs/grpo_additive_bonus_b01.yaml"
        REWARD_MODE="additive_bonus"
        OUT_DIR="${OUT_BASE}/d134_4b_isr_b01_s${SEED}"
    else
        CONFIG="configs/grpo_additive_random_b01.yaml"
        REWARD_MODE="additive_random"
        OUT_DIR="${OUT_BASE}/d134_4b_random_b01_s${SEED}"
    fi
    
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "[$(date -u)] Starting ${CONDITION} β=0.1 seed=${SEED}"
    echo "=========================================="
    
    mkdir -p "${OUT_DIR}"
    
    # Train
    python3 scripts/train_grpo.py \
        --config ${CONFIG} \
        --data_path data/train_500_seed42.jsonl \
        --num_steps 500 \
        --seed ${SEED} \
        --beta 0.1 \
        --reward_mode ${REWARD_MODE} \
        --per_device_batch_size 2 \
        --gradient_accumulation_steps 4 \
        --output_dir ${OUT_DIR} \
        --no_wandb \
        2>&1 | tee ${OUT_DIR}/train.log
    
    echo "[$(date -u)] Training done, starting eval..."
    
    # Eval (greedy)
    python3 scripts/eval_sta.py \
        --model_path ${OUT_DIR} \
        --data_path data/train_500_seed42.jsonl \
        --solver prover9 \
        --output_dir ${OUT_DIR}/eval_greedy \
        --decoding greedy \
        --max_samples 100 \
        2>&1 | tee ${OUT_DIR}/eval.log
    
    echo "[$(date -u)] Eval done, starting classify..."
    
    # Classify
    python3 scripts/classify_h7.py \
        --input_path ${OUT_DIR}/eval_greedy/results.jsonl \
        --output_path ${OUT_DIR}/eval_greedy/classified.jsonl \
        2>&1 | tee ${OUT_DIR}/classify.log
    
    echo "[$(date -u)] ✅ ${CONDITION} β=0.1 seed=${SEED} COMPLETE"
    echo ""
}
